info.title: Tickets API
info.description: Workspace REST API. Cookie mutations require matching Origin. Invalid Authorization never falls back to a session cookie. Pagination is ascending ID except descending ticket history. Markdown HTML is sanitized. Full behavioral reference: /api-docs.

post.description: Matching Origin required. Sets HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax tickets_session for seven days. Rate limited to five attempts per 15 minutes.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Required; must equal the request URL origin even when an Authorization header is supplied.

Set-Cookie.description: HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax tickets_session; Path=/; Max-Age=604800.
